metaDescription: Order custom gray wine tumblers for your brand. Perfect for events and gifts. Shop bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray wine tumblers offer a sleek, neutral backdrop for your logo, making them a versatile choice for corporate events, trade shows, or employee gifts. The subtle tone pairs well with any color imprint, from bold metallics to understated monograms. Choose from double-wall vacuum-insulated options like the 13 oz KOOZIE® Triple Vacuum Tumbler to keep drinks at the perfect temperature. These tumblers are durable, dishwasher safe, and designed for repeated use, ensuring your brand stays visible long after the event.
heroAltText: Custom gray wine tumblers with logo imprint, ideal for corporate gifts and events.
